terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: These terms explain how you may use PhumiReader, a place to read comics and web novels in Khmer and English.

sections.p: You may read, subscribe, like and comment for personal use. Do not copy, resell or scrape stories, and do not misuse the site.
Keep your password private. You are responsible for what happens under your account. We may suspend accounts that break these terms.
Coins are bought with the payment methods shown at checkout and unlock Fast Pass episodes. Prices and refund rules are [PRICE AND REFUND POLICY].
Creators keep the rights to their work and promise that they own what they publish. We may hide content that breaks the rules or the law.
Be kind. Comments that are abusive, hateful or spam may be hidden. You can report any series, episode or comment.
We may update these terms and will show the date above. Questions: [SUPPORT EMAIL].

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This page explains what PhumiReader collects about you, why, and the choices you have.

sections.p: Your name, email address, reading activity (progress, subscriptions, likes, bookmarks), coin purchases and the comments you write.
To run your account, remember where you stopped reading, process payments, keep the site safe and send the emails you ask for.
Payment providers, our email and hosting providers, and only what they need. We do not sell your data. Details: [PROVIDER LIST].
We use cookies to keep you signed in and to protect forms, and local storage for your reading settings.
You can change your details and notification settings in Settings. You can delete your account there; your personal data is erased after a 30-day grace period.

help.title: Help center
help.intro: Answers to common questions. Cannot find yours? Write to us.

faq.a: Open Coins from the menu, choose a pack and pay with KHQR, ABA Pay or card. The coins are added as soon as the payment is confirmed.
Some new episodes can be read early for a few coins. Every Fast Pass episode becomes free for everyone after the date shown on it.

faq.q: I paid but my coins did not arrive.
faq.a: Wait a minute and reload Coins. If the order still shows as pending, contact us with the order number from your purchase history.

faq.q: How do I become a creator?
faq.a: Open Creator in the menu and accept the Creator terms. You can then create a series and upload episodes.

faq.q: How do I delete my account?
faq.a: Go to Settings > Account > Delete account. Your account is erased after a 30-day grace period; logging in during that time keeps it.

faq.q: How do I report a problem with a story or comment?
faq.a: Use the Report button on the series, episode or comment. Our team reviews every report.
